description: Make a NEW design: uploaded artwork placed on the front and/or back of a garment. To show or order a design that already exists, find it with list_designs first; don't create a new design for the same artwork. Ask the person what to call it (title) and list every warning code in acknowledgedWarnings. A new design is not approved for printing until activate_design.

acknowledgedWarnings.description: Every warning code the artwork or placement raised

adjust.description: collar-v1 only; omit for the rule as is.

align.description: box = true center, visual = ink-weighted center

dyIn.description: Inches; + = down, away from the collar

scale.description: Fraction of the rule's size, above 0 and at most 1

placement.description: print-area-v1 only: size and position in inches inside the print area.

centerXIn.description: Inches from the center line; 0 = centered

topOffsetIn.description: Inches from the top of the print area

placementModel.description: collar-v1 = placed by the collar with an optional adjust; hem-v1 = Low hem (preset low-hem); omitted = a print-area placement.

preset.description: Print position instead of adjust, e.g. left-chest. low-hem: Low hem, only on accounts that have it turned on: a small print just above the bottom hem (the LS14 hoodie: low on the front pocket), front only, nothing else to send.
